definitions.short: Amarjah , the name of nine Israelites
definitions.full: H568. Amaryahu or Amaryah אֲמַרְיָה אֲמַרְי֫הוּ proper name, masculine ( Yah(u) hath promised , compare Palmyrene אֶמרשמשא Sabean יתעאמר ) long form only 1Chr 24:23 ; 2Chr 19:11 ; 31:15 . 1 a Levite 1Chr 23:19 ; 24:23 (in David's time), compare 1 Chronicles 5:33 (twice in verse); 6:37 ; Ezra 7:3 ; see also 2 1 Chronicles 5:37 (twice in verse); also 3 Ezra 10:42 . 4 chief priest under Jehosh . 2Chr 19:11 . 5 Levite under Hezekiah 2Chr 31:15 . 6 son of Hezekiah & great-grandfather of Zephaniah Zeph 1:1 . 7 a priest Neh 10:4 ; 12:2 , 13 . 8 a man of Judah Neh 11:4 .
definitions.rootNote: or prolonged אֲמַרְיָהוּ ; from 559 and 3050 ; Jah has said (i.e. promised);
